title: Continents And Important Cities Of The World
definition: Comprehensive study of continental landmasses, their structural geology, major physiographic divisions, and the spatial distribution of strategically, economically, and historically important global cities.
importanceInUpsc: Crucial for UPSC Prelims (map-based questions on cities near rivers, seas, deserts, straits) and Mains GS-1 (World Geography, urbanization trends, geomorphological features).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Continents And Important Cities Of The World.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
